link_description: Users must contribute and reuse knowledge for the platform to matter
Knowledge reuse must improve decision quality
Stakeholder participation must create legitimacy for redesign
Redesign must reduce user burden without increasing frontline burden
Foresight outputs must be used in real decisions
Performance targets must improve outcomes rather than create gaming
AI workflow must improve idea quality not amplify weak frames
Portfolio governance must stop weak pilots
Equity review must influence decisions rather than become ritual
Burden and harm must be visible before implementation
